newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks mixed to firmer in London.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks mixed to firmer in London.

text.p: Japanese shares were mixed to firmer in London on Wednesday following a 1.7-percent rally in the market in Tokyo.
At 1400 GMT, the Nikkei 50 average was up 37.59 points to 1,644.27 in London.
Dealers said activity was light, with most interest focused on Sanwa Bank Ltd, whose shares were bid around 1700 yen, the closing level in Tokyo.
They noted some selling interest in Hitachi Ltd shares around their Tokyo closing level at 1330 yen.
"But overall, it's very quiet," a dealer added.
In Tokyo, the Nikkei 225 index gained 337.34 points to 20,679.27.
